script_content: <#  .SYNOPSIS  Skrip Pengujian Otomatis PowerShell Per Skenario untuk Rule-Based SIEM  #>    # =====================================================================  # KONFIGURASI  # =====================================================================  $basePath = \"C:\\TA\\project-ta\\data_spliting\"    # PILIH SKENARIO YANG INGIN DIUJI SAAT INI  # Pilihan: \"benign\", \"malicious\", \"ASCII_Encoding\", \"String_Concatenation\", \"String_Reordering\", \"Token_Manipulation\"  $currentScenario = \"benign\"     $targetDir = switch ($currentScenario) {      \"benign\"               { \"$basePath\\test_set\\benign\" }      \"malicious\"            { \"$basePath\\test_set\\malicious\" }      \"ASCII_Encoding\"       { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\ASCII_Encoding\\malicious\" }      \"String_Concatenation\" { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Concatenation\\malicious\" }      \"String_Reordering\"    { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Reordering\\malicious\" }      \"Token_Manipulation\"   { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\Token_Manipulation\\malicious\" }      Default                { throw \"Skenario tidak dikenal!\" }  }    # File progress otomatis menyesuaikan dengan nama skenario[cite: 1]  $progressFile = \"$basePath\\progress_rule_$currentScenario.txt\"    # Jeda cepat khusus Rule-Based  $SleepTimeMs = 250  # =====================================================================    if (!(Test-Path $targetDir)) {       Write-Host \"[ERROR] Folder tidak ditemukan: $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Red      exit   }    # Filter file .ps1 dan urutkan berdasarkan nama agar konsisten[cite: 1]  $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDir -Filter \"*.ps1\" | Sort-Object Name  $totalFiles = $files.Count    if ($totalFiles -eq 0) {      Write-Host \"[!] Tidak ada file .ps1 yang ditemukan di dalam folder $targetDir.\" -ForegroundColor Yellow      exit  }    # Membaca progress terakhir[cite: 1]  $lastProcessed = if (Test-Path $progressFile) { (Get-Content $progressFile).Trim() } else { \"\" }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" MODE PENGUJIAN RULE-BASED : $currentScenario\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Lokasi Folder             : $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Total File                : $totalFiles\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan    $skipMode = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lastProcessed)) { $false } else { $true }  $currentIndex = 0     foreach ($file in $files) {      $currentIndex++            # -------------------------------------------------------------      # LOGIKA RESUME: Melewati file yang sudah dieksekusi sebelumnya[cite: 1]      # -------------------------------------------------------------      if ($skipMode -and ($file.Name -eq $lastProcessed)) {          Write-Host \"--> Melompati $($file.Name) (Sudah diproses terakhir kali)\" -ForegroundColor Gray          $skipMode = $false          continue      }            if ($skipMode) { continue }      # -------------------------------------------------------------        $percent = [math]::Round(($currentIndex / $totalFiles) * 100, 2)      Write-Host \"[$currentIndex/$totalFiles] ($percent%) Memproses -> $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Yellow            try {          # Eksekusi mode aman, tanpa pop-up (NonInteractive)          $arguments = \"-NonInteractive -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `\"$($file.FullName)`\"\"          Start-Process -FilePath \"powershell.exe\" -ArgumentList $arguments -WindowStyle Hidden -Wait                    # Mencatat nama file yang sukses ke file progress[cite: 1]          $file.Name | Out-File $progressFile -Encoding ascii      } catch {          Write-Host \"  [!] Gagal memproses $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Red      }        # Jeda untuk mencegah flooding ke agen Wazuh      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $SleepTimeMs  }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \" [OK] PENGUJIAN SKENARIO '$currentScenario' SELESAI!\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green

rule_info: Rule 91819: Powershell script searching filesystem
script_content: <#  .SYNOPSIS  Skrip Pengujian Otomatis PowerShell Per Skenario untuk Rule-Based SIEM  #>    # =====================================================================  # KONFIGURASI  # =====================================================================  $basePath = \"C:\\TA\\project-ta\\data_spliting\"    # PILIH SKENARIO YANG INGIN DIUJI SAAT INI  # Pilihan: \"benign\", \"malicious\", \"ASCII_Encoding\", \"String_Concatenation\", \"String_Reordering\", \"Token_Manipulation\"  $currentScenario = \"benign\"     $targetDir = switch ($currentScenario) {      \"benign\"               { \"$basePath\\test_set\\benign\" }      \"malicious\"            { \"$basePath\\test_set\\malicious\" }      \"ASCII_Encoding\"       { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\ASCII_Encoding\\malicious\" }      \"String_Concatenation\" { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Concatenation\\malicious\" }      \"String_Reordering\"    { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Reordering\\malicious\" }      \"Token_Manipulation\"   { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\Token_Manipulation\\malicious\" }      Default                { throw \"Skenario tidak dikenal!\" }  }    # File progress otomatis menyesuaikan dengan nama skenario[cite: 1]  $progressFile = \"$basePath\\progress_rule_$currentScenario.txt\"    # Jeda cepat khusus Rule-Based  $SleepTimeMs = 250  # =====================================================================    if (!(Test-Path $targetDir)) {       Write-Host \"[ERROR] Folder tidak ditemukan: $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Red      exit   }    # Filter file .ps1 dan urutkan berdasarkan nama agar konsisten[cite: 1]  $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDir -Filter \"*.ps1\" | Sort-Object Name  $totalFiles = $files.Count    if ($totalFiles -eq 0) {      Write-Host \"[!] Tidak ada file .ps1 yang ditemukan di dalam folder $targetDir.\" -ForegroundColor Yellow      exit  }    # Membaca progress terakhir[cite: 1]  $lastProcessed = if (Test-Path $progressFile) { (Get-Content $progressFile).Trim() } else { \"\" }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" MODE PENGUJIAN RULE-BASED : $currentScenario\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Lokasi Folder             : $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Total File                : $totalFiles\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan    $skipMode = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lastProcessed)) { $false } else { $true }  $currentIndex = 0     foreach ($file in $files) {      $currentIndex++            # -------------------------------------------------------------      # LOGIKA RESUME: Melewati file yang sudah dieksekusi sebelumnya[cite: 1]      # -------------------------------------------------------------      if ($skipMode -and ($file.Name -eq $lastProcessed)) {          Write-Host \"--> Melompati $($file.Name) (Sudah diproses terakhir kali)\" -ForegroundColor Gray          $skipMode = $false          continue      }            if ($skipMode) { continue }      # -------------------------------------------------------------        $percent = [math]::Round(($currentIndex / $totalFiles) * 100, 2)      Write-Host \"[$currentIndex/$totalFiles] ($percent%) Memproses -> $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Yellow            try {          # HAPUS parameter -Wait dan GANTI dengan -PassThru agar proses bisa dilacak          $arguments = \"-NonInteractive -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `\"$($file.FullName)`\"\"          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath \"powershell.exe\" -ArgumentList $arguments -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru                    # Waktu hidup maksimal (Kill-Switch): 500 milidetik          Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500                    # Jika dalam 500ms malware belum selesai/nyangkut, BUNUH PAKSA!          if (-not $proc.HasExited) {              Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue          }                    # Mencatat nama file yang sukses dieksekusi (atau sukses dibunuh) ke file progress          $file.Name | Out-File $progressFile -Encoding ascii      } catch {          Write-Host \"  [!] Gagal memproses $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Red      }        # Jeda untuk mencegah flooding ke agen Wazuh      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $SleepTimeMs  }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \" [OK] PENGUJIAN SKENARIO '$currentScenario' SELESAI!\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green

PILIH SKENARIO YANG INGIN DIUJI SAAT INI  # Pilihan: \"benign\", \"malicious\", \"ASCII_Encoding\", \"String_Concatenation\", \"String_Reordering\", \"Token_Manipulation\"  $currentScenario = \"malicious\"     $targetDir = switch ($currentScenario) {      \"benign\"               { \"$basePath\\test_set\\benign\" }      \"malicious\"            { \"$basePath\\test_set\\malicious\" }      \"ASCII_Encoding\"       { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\ASCII_Encoding\\malicious\" }      \"String_Concatenation\" { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Concatenation\\malicious\" }      \"String_Reordering\"    { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Reordering\\malicious\" }      \"Token_Manipulation\"   { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\Token_Manipulation\\malicious\" }      Default                { throw \"Skenario tidak dikenal!\" }  }    # File progress otomatis menyesuaikan dengan nama skenario[cite: 1]  $progressFile = \"$basePath\\progress_rule_$currentScenario.txt\"    # Jeda cepat khusus Rule-Based  $SleepTimeMs = 250  # =====================================================================    if (!(Test-Path $targetDir)) {       Write-Host \"[ERROR] Folder tidak ditemukan: $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Red      exit   }    # Filter file .ps1 dan urutkan berdasarkan nama agar konsisten[cite: 1]  $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDir -Filter \"*.ps1\" | Sort-Object Name  $totalFiles = $files.Count    if ($totalFiles -eq 0) {      Write-Host \"[!] Tidak ada file .ps1 yang ditemukan di dalam folder $targetDir.\" -ForegroundColor Yellow      exit  }    # Membaca progress terakhir[cite: 1]  $lastProcessed = if (Test-Path $progressFile) { (Get-Content $progressFile).Trim() } else { \"\" }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" MODE PENGUJIAN RULE-BASED : $currentScenario\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Lokasi Folder             : $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Total File                : $totalFiles\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan    $skipMode = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lastProcessed)) { $false } else { $true }  $currentIndex = 0     foreach ($file in $files) {      $currentIndex++            # -------------------------------------------------------------      # LOGIKA RESUME: Melewati file yang sudah dieksekusi sebelumnya[cite: 1]      # -------------------------------------------------------------      if ($skipMode -and ($file.Name -eq $lastProcessed)) {          Write-Host \"--> Melompati $($file.Name) (Sudah diproses terakhir kali)\" -ForegroundColor Gray          $skipMode = $false          continue      }            if ($skipMode) { continue }      # -------------------------------------------------------------        $percent = [math]::Round(($currentIndex / $totalFiles) * 100, 2)      Write-Host \"[$currentIndex/$totalFiles] ($percent%) Memproses -> $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Yellow            try {          # HAPUS parameter -Wait dan GANTI dengan -PassThru agar proses bisa dilacak          $arguments = \"-NonInteractive -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `\"$($file.FullName)`\"\"          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath \"powershell.exe\" -ArgumentList $arguments -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru                    # Waktu hidup maksimal (Kill-Switch): 500 milidetik          Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500                    # Jika dalam 500ms malware belum selesai/nyangkut, BUNUH PAKSA!          if (-not $proc.HasExited) {              Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue          }                    # Mencatat nama file yang sukses dieksekusi (atau sukses dibunuh) ke file progress          $file.Name | Out-File $progressFile -Encoding ascii      } catch {          Write-Host \"  [!] Gagal memproses $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Red      }        # Jeda untuk mencegah flooding ke agen Wazuh      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $SleepTimeMs  }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \" [OK] PENGUJIAN SKENARIO '$currentScenario' SELESAI!\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green

PILIH SKENARIO YANG INGIN DIUJI SAAT INI  # Pilihan: \"benign\", \"malicious\", \"ASCII_Encoding\", \"String_Concatenation\", \"String_Reordering\", \"Token_Manipulation\"  $currentScenario = \"String_Concatenation\"     $targetDir = switch ($currentScenario) {      \"benign\"               { \"$basePath\\test_set\\benign\" }      \"malicious\"            { \"$basePath\\test_set\\malicious\" }      \"ASCII_Encoding\"       { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\ASCII_Encoding\\malicious\" }      \"String_Concatenation\" { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Concatenation\\malicious\" }      \"String_Reordering\"    { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Reordering\\malicious\" }      \"Token_Manipulation\"   { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\Token_Manipulation\\malicious\" }      Default                { throw \"Skenario tidak dikenal!\" }  }    # File progress otomatis menyesuaikan dengan nama skenario[cite: 1]  $progressFile = \"$basePath\\progress_rule_$currentScenario.txt\"    # Jeda cepat khusus Rule-Based  $SleepTimeMs = 250  # =====================================================================    if (!(Test-Path $targetDir)) {       Write-Host \"[ERROR] Folder tidak ditemukan: $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Red      exit   }    # Filter file .ps1 dan urutkan berdasarkan nama agar konsisten[cite: 1]  $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDir -Filter \"*.ps1\" | Sort-Object Name  $totalFiles = $files.Count    if ($totalFiles -eq 0) {      Write-Host \"[!] Tidak ada file .ps1 yang ditemukan di dalam folder $targetDir.\" -ForegroundColor Yellow      exit  }    # Membaca progress terakhir[cite: 1]  $lastProcessed = if (Test-Path $progressFile) { (Get-Content $progressFile).Trim() } else { \"\" }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" MODE PENGUJIAN RULE-BASED : $currentScenario\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Lokasi Folder             : $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Total File                : $totalFiles\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan    $skipMode = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lastProcessed)) { $false } else { $true }  $currentIndex = 0     foreach ($file in $files) {      $currentIndex++            # -------------------------------------------------------------      # LOGIKA RESUME: Melewati file yang sudah dieksekusi sebelumnya[cite: 1]      # -------------------------------------------------------------      if ($skipMode -and ($file.Name -eq $lastProcessed)) {          Write-Host \"--> Melompati $($file.Name) (Sudah diproses terakhir kali)\" -ForegroundColor Gray          $skipMode = $false          continue      }            if ($skipMode) { continue }      # -------------------------------------------------------------        $percent = [math]::Round(($currentIndex / $totalFiles) * 100, 2)      Write-Host \"[$currentIndex/$totalFiles] ($percent%) Memproses -> $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Yellow            try {          # HAPUS parameter -Wait dan GANTI dengan -PassThru agar proses bisa dilacak          $arguments = \"-NonInteractive -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `\"$($file.FullName)`\"\"          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath \"powershell.exe\" -ArgumentList $arguments -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru                    # Waktu hidup maksimal (Kill-Switch): 500 milidetik          Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500                    # Jika dalam 500ms malware belum selesai/nyangkut, BUNUH PAKSA!          if (-not $proc.HasExited) {              Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue          }                    # Mencatat nama file yang sukses dieksekusi (atau sukses dibunuh) ke file progress          $file.Name | Out-File $progressFile -Encoding ascii      } catch {          Write-Host \"  [!] Gagal memproses $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Red      }        # Jeda untuk mencegah flooding ke agen Wazuh      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $SleepTimeMs  }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \" [OK] PENGUJIAN SKENARIO '$currentScenario' SELESAI!\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green

rule_info: Rule 91819: Powershell script searching filesystem
script_content: <#  .SYNOPSIS  Skrip Pengujian Otomatis PowerShell Per Skenario untuk Rule-Based SIEM  #>    # =====================================================================  # KONFIGURASI  # =====================================================================  $basePath = \"C:\\TA\\project-ta\\data_spliting\"    # PILIH SKENARIO YANG INGIN DIUJI SAAT INI  # Pilihan: \"benign\", \"malicious\", \"ASCII_Encoding\", \"String_Concatenation\", \"String_Reordering\", \"Token_Manipulation\"  $currentScenario = \"String_Reordering\"     $targetDir = switch ($currentScenario) {      \"benign\"               { \"$basePath\\test_set\\benign\" }      \"malicious\"            { \"$basePath\\test_set\\malicious\" }      \"ASCII_Encoding\"       { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\ASCII_Encoding\\malicious\" }      \"String_Concatenation\" { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Concatenation\\malicious\" }      \"String_Reordering\"    { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\String_Reordering\\malicious\" }      \"Token_Manipulation\"   { \"$basePath\\test_set_obf\\Token_Manipulation\\malicious\" }      Default                { throw \"Skenario tidak dikenal!\" }  }    # File progress otomatis menyesuaikan dengan nama skenario[cite: 1]  $progressFile = \"$basePath\\progress_rule_$currentScenario.txt\"    # Jeda cepat khusus Rule-Based  $SleepTimeMs = 250  # =====================================================================    if (!(Test-Path $targetDir)) {       Write-Host \"[ERROR] Folder tidak ditemukan: $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Red      exit   }    # Filter file .ps1 dan urutkan berdasarkan nama agar konsisten[cite: 1]  $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDir -Filter \"*.ps1\" | Sort-Object Name  $totalFiles = $files.Count    if ($totalFiles -eq 0) {      Write-Host \"[!] Tidak ada file .ps1 yang ditemukan di dalam folder $targetDir.\" -ForegroundColor Yellow      exit  }    # Membaca progress terakhir[cite: 1]  $lastProcessed = if (Test-Path $progressFile) { (Get-Content $progressFile).Trim() } else { \"\" }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" MODE PENGUJIAN RULE-BASED : $currentScenario\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Lokasi Folder             : $targetDir\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \" Total File                : $totalFiles\" -ForegroundColor Cyan  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan    $skipMode = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($lastProcessed)) { $false } else { $true }  $currentIndex = 0     foreach ($file in $files) {      $currentIndex++            # -------------------------------------------------------------      # LOGIKA RESUME: Melewati file yang sudah dieksekusi sebelumnya[cite: 1]      # -------------------------------------------------------------      if ($skipMode -and ($file.Name -eq $lastProcessed)) {          Write-Host \"--> Melompati $($file.Name) (Sudah diproses terakhir kali)\" -ForegroundColor Gray          $skipMode = $false          continue      }            if ($skipMode) { continue }      # -------------------------------------------------------------        $percent = [math]::Round(($currentIndex / $totalFiles) * 100, 2)      Write-Host \"[$currentIndex/$totalFiles] ($percent%) Memproses -> $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Yellow            try {          # HAPUS parameter -Wait dan GANTI dengan -PassThru agar proses bisa dilacak          $arguments = \"-NonInteractive -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `\"$($file.FullName)`\"\"          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath \"powershell.exe\" -ArgumentList $arguments -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru                    # Waktu hidup maksimal (Kill-Switch): 500 milidetik          Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500                    # Jika dalam 500ms malware belum selesai/nyangkut, BUNUH PAKSA!          if (-not $proc.HasExited) {              Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue          }                    # Mencatat nama file yang sukses dieksekusi (atau sukses dibunuh) ke file progress          $file.Name | Out-File $progressFile -Encoding ascii      } catch {          Write-Host \"  [!] Gagal memproses $($file.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Red      }        # Jeda untuk mencegah flooding ke agen Wazuh      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $SleepTimeMs  }    Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \" [OK] PENGUJIAN SKENARIO '$currentScenario' SELESAI!\" -ForegroundColor Green  Write-Host \"======================================================\" -ForegroundColor Green
